dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Here. While it’s warm.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Your hands are still shaking.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: They’ll stop.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: So will mine, if I give them a minute.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: How far to the entrance?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Beyond the ridge. There’s some climbing yet.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: I can manage.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I know. I’m asking you to rest.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: *looks across the valley* There are still people in those houses.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: The carts are going back for another group.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: And when we leave here, we’re going the other way.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Another surge could take that road. We need to reach the source.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: I wish we could tell them more than ‘we’ll do what we can.’

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: We got the first carts through. They saw that.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: I was thinking about the mill.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Halden’s?

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: I cleared that little recess and felt as if I’d done something remarkable.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: You cleared the catch so I could work on it. We needed that.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: *a faint smile* You told me that then, too.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I meant it then, too.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: You didn’t seem nervous.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I was. It helped having a problem I could understand.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: A broken catch. A branch in the water.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: And two of us to deal with it.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: I wish it were that simple again.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: So do I.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: But we’re going in.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: When you’re ready.

dialogue.speaker: Caelan
dialogue.text: Give me a moment.

narrative_note: Approved expanded late-Game-I framing scene. The entrance beyond the ridge, threatened valley road, another surge and evacuation carts are established within this opening. Exact later-act placement and wider causes remain provisional. The scene establishes no casualties, Tomas outcome, full companion roster, antagonist responsibility, temple origin, ancient identity or cosmic revelation. A future full reprise must continue this quiet moment into the consequential decision.

pacing.reading_note: Short replies use shorter holds; longer lines retain time to read. The four-second quiet beat contains sitting, sipping and lowering.
